title: Electric Service Agreement Reconnection Charge — Amount Charged on a Reconnection Order
content:
Field Services states the reconnection charge posted with a reconnection order on an Electric Service Agreement as follows.

> The reconnection charge is the schedule's field reconnection charge for standard hours, rounded to the cent.

The charge is figured once for the order, from the schedule the agreement is billed under, and only the final reconnection charge is rounded to the cent. It is a single charge, dated the order date.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Hypothetical schedule's field reconnection charge for standard hours | Reconnection charge posted |
|---|---|
| 85.00 USD | 85.00 USD |
| 140.00 USD | 140.00 USD |

The schedule's figure is read from the reconnection charge values of the schedule; the charge posted is that figure stated to the cent.
